Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  October 16, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on October 16, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre –
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-
  Banks - District 4, Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. Commissioner Metcalf moved to table the approval of the minutes until they
were amended to include a summary of the guest speakers' presentations. Commissioner
Banks seconded and the motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Banks, and Lesure.
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Public Art Program Transferring to the Library Department - Parks, Recreation and
  Community Services Director, Thomas Uwal announced that this would be the
  final meeting under his department’s leadership, as oversight of the Public Art
  Program will transition to the Library Services Department beginning in
  November. He assured the Commission that the program would be in capable
  hands and expressed his gratitude for the opportunity to work with the
  Commission.
  b. Inglewood Open Studios Art Walk - Acting Library Services Director Kerri Arroyo
  provided an update on the Library’s involvement in the 2024 Open Studios Art
  Walk. She shared that the Library will be hosting artwork from students at West
  Los Angeles College and El Camino College. Additionally, the Library will feature
  live music performances on the patio during the event. She encouraged Arts
  Commission members to attend and support the local arts community.

  1
   Arts Commission

  c. Children’s Library Entry - Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh presented the new
  entry design for the Children’s Library, which will be implemented as part of the
  upcoming renovation. The entrance will feature a circular design incorporating
  multimedia and digital art displays. These digital artworks will be updated
  regularly to create an engaging and dynamic space for Inglewood’s youth.

PUBLIC REMARKS. Jorge Gomez invited all to attend the Inglewood Art Walk and to a
group show at Lalo’s Grill. Thomas Uwal announced the following upcoming Parks,
Recreation, and Community Services events: the Halloween Family Festival on October
19 at City Hall on the South Lawn; a Halloween party for seniors at the Senior Center on
October 31 from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.; the Turkey Giveaway on November 20; and the
Tree Lighting Ceremony on December 2.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Next Arts Commission Meeting: November 20, 2024 at 6:30 p.m.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:32 p.m.
